name: The Strange Man
region: Lemoyne — Bayall Edge, near Mattock Pond
where: A cabin at Bayall Edge, across the Kamassa from the country north of Rhodes, near Mattock Pond. A photograph of him is also inside the general store in Armadillo, which means the epilogue.
steps: Ride to the Bayall Edge cabin and go inside.
On early visits you can find a hat and an unfinished portrait. You will not get a fight.
Leave and return over the course of the story. The portrait stays unfinished until you reach 100% completion.
At 100%, the portrait is finished and he appears briefly in the mirror.
In the epilogue, the Armadillo general store has his photograph.
requirements: The cabin can be visited during the story. The mirror appearance is tied to 100% completion. Armadillo is epilogue country.
reward: Journal entries and the mirror appearance. There is no weapon or cash payout.

markers.title: Strange Man's cabin
markers.directions: Cross the Kamassa to the cabin at Bayall Edge, near Mattock Pond and north of Rhodes.
markers.note: Not a combat encounter. The mirror scene waits for 100% completion.

name: Saint Denis vampire
region: Lemoyne — Saint Denis
where: Five writings on walls around Saint Denis, then an alley by the cathedral.
steps: Read the writings near the general store, the Fontana Theatre, the gunsmith, the trapper, and Doyle's Tavern.
Come back to the alley beside the cathedral between midnight and 1:00 a.m. Save before you go in.
He is there feeding. You can kill him or hogtie him.
Take the Ornate Dagger from the body. It is missable.
If he kills you, some players report that he never returns. Reload the save if that happens.
requirements: Night, after the writings, in the midnight to 1:00 a.m. window. Saint Denis must be open to you.
reward: The Ornate Dagger.
uncertain: The 'he never comes back if he kills you' line is widely reported. Save first so you do not have to test it.

markers.title: Saint Denis vampire
markers.directions: After the five wall writings, stand in the alley by the cathedral from midnight to 1:00 a.m.
markers.note: Save first. The Ornate Dagger is the reward.

name: Emerald Ranch UFO
region: New Hanover — north of Emerald Station
where: A shack north of Emerald Station and northeast of Heartland Overflow.
steps: Find the shack and read the note inside.
Leave, then return at 2:00 a.m.
Look up. A green light passes over.
requirements: 2:00 a.m. on a return visit, after you have read the note.
reward: The sighting and a journal entry. No item is confirmed.

markers.title: UFO shack
markers.region: New Hanover — north of Emerald Station
markers.directions: Ride north of Emerald Station, northeast of Heartland Overflow, and read the note in the shack. Return at 2:00 a.m. and look up.
markers.note: The Mount Shann stone circle belongs to the same mystery.

name: Mount Shann stone circle
region: West Elizabeth — Mount Shann
where: A stone circle with strange markings on Mount Shann, tied to the same UFO mystery as the Emerald shack.
steps: Climb Mount Shann and inspect the stone circle.
Read the markings into the journal.
Use it with the Emerald shack sighting. This circle is not a second timed UFO event.
requirements: You can climb Mount Shann once that part of West Elizabeth is open. No clock is confirmed for the circle itself.
reward: Journal drawings. The timed light is at the Emerald shack, not here.

markers.title: Mount Shann stone circle
markers.directions: Climb Mount Shann and inspect the marked stones. This is separate from the summit sundial and from the giant's cave.
markers.note: Part of the UFO mystery. The 2:00 a.m. light is at the shack north of Emerald Station.

name: New Austin UFO wreck
region: New Austin — reported, not pinned
where: A second wreck somewhere in New Austin is often discussed.
steps: Do not ride to a pin for this one. This guide does not have a confirmed spot or a confirmed trigger.
Claims that it appears only after 100% completion were not verified here.
requirements: Unconfirmed.
reward: Unconfirmed. Nothing is promised.
uncertain: Location and trigger were not confirmed, so there is no marker.

name: Giant's skeleton
region: West Elizabeth — cave near the top of Mount Shann
where: A cave close to the summit of Mount Shann.
steps: Climb Mount Shann.
Enter the cave near the top.
Inspect the giant skeleton. There is no living Bigfoot to fight.
requirements: West Elizabeth access. No chapter clock is confirmed beyond being able to climb the mountain.
reward: The skeleton and a journal entry.

markers.title: Giant's skeleton
markers.directions: Near the summit of Mount Shann, enter the cave and inspect the skeleton.
markers.note: A giant skeleton, not a living creature. The same cave is on the Hidden Places map.

name: Northern talking cave
region: Ambarino — reported, not pinned
where: Players report a cave in northern Ambarino with a blocked mouth and a voice inside.
steps: This guide does not pin it.
Do not expect a visible Bigfoot. The voice, if you find that cave, is reported and may be unused content.
requirements: Unconfirmed.
reward: Unconfirmed.
uncertain: Reported only. No verified entrance or reward.

name: Ghost train
region: Lemoyne — Scarlett Meadows
where: The tracks near the Welcome to Lemoyne sign.
steps: Save, then wait on those tracks around 3:00 a.m.
It does not run every night. If the tracks stay empty, sleep and try another night.
Stay off the rails when it appears. It can kill you. There is nothing to loot.
requirements: About 3:00 a.m., and not guaranteed on a given night.
reward: The sighting only.

markers.title: Ghost train tracks
markers.directions: Stand near the Welcome to Lemoyne sign around 3:00 a.m. and watch the tracks. Not every night.
markers.note: It can run you down. No item reward.

name: Ghost of Bayou Nwa (Agnes Dowd)
region: Lemoyne — Bluewater Marsh
where: Bluewater Marsh, at Agnes Dowd's haunting and her grave.
steps: Ride into Bluewater Marsh after dark and look for her with binoculars or a scope.
Do not walk up to her. She vanishes if you get too close.
Visit more than once. The journal fills in across repeat visits.
This guide does not pick a clock. Published hours conflict.
requirements: After dark in Bluewater Marsh. Exact hours are not settled.
reward: Journal entries for the haunting. No unique weapon is confirmed.
uncertain: One guide window is about 9 p.m. to 3 a.m. Another gives a different evening span. Some say it takes as many as 16 visits. Those details conflict, so they are not treated as fact.

markers.title: Agnes Dowd
markers.directions: Search Bluewater Marsh after dark with binoculars. Stay back so she does not vanish.
markers.note: Exact hours conflict between guides and are not pinned to a clock.

name: Serial killer (American Dreams)
region: Valentine, Big Valley, and Scarlett Meadows
where: Three murder scenes, then Lucky's Cabin southwest of Valentine.
steps: At night, between 10 p.m. and 5 a.m., find the scene south of Valentine under the railroad tracks. The rock reads LOOK ON MY WORKS. Take the map piece from the severed head.
Find the scene southwest of Wallace Station. The rock reads DO YOU SEE?
Find the scene east of Braithwaite Manor. The tree reads BEHOLD.
Open the reassembled map in your satchel, then go to the burned cabin southwest of Valentine.
Open the basement, read the letters, and inspect the knife.
Knock him down, hogtie Edmund Lowry Jr., and carry him to the sheriff in Valentine.
When he attacks the sheriff, shoot him. If you are too slow, the sheriff kills him and you are not paid.
requirements: Available from Chapter 2. The three scenes are only found between 10 p.m. and 5 a.m.
reward: About $20, if you kill Lowry when he turns on the sheriff. Some reports say honor nudges the amount. Missing the shot pays nothing.

markers.title: Murder scene — Look on My Works
markers.region: New Hanover — under the tracks south of Valentine
markers.directions: South of Valentine, under the railroad tracks, between 10 p.m. and 5 a.m. Read LOOK ON MY WORKS and take the map piece.
markers.note: One of three scenes. The killer is not here.

markers.title: Murder scene — Do You See
markers.region: West Elizabeth — southwest of Wallace Station
markers.directions: Southwest of Wallace Station, between 10 p.m. and 5 a.m. The boulder reads DO YOU SEE?
markers.note: Second map piece.

markers.title: Murder scene — Behold
markers.directions: East of Braithwaite Manor, between 10 p.m. and 5 a.m. The tree reads BEHOLD.
markers.note: Third map piece.

markers.title: Lucky's Cabin basement
markers.directions: After all three map pieces, open the basement at the burned cabin southwest of Valentine.
markers.note: American Dreams. Shoot Lowry when he attacks the sheriff.

name: Viking burial
region: New Hanover — shore northeast of Annesburg
where: A burial mound on the rocky shore northeast of Annesburg, in Roanoke Ridge. Guides often place it under the R in the word Roanoke on the world map.
steps: Ride the coast northeast of Annesburg.
Search the rocks for the mound.
Inspect the burial and pick up the helmet and the hatchet.
requirements: Roanoke Ridge access. No clock or chapter gate is confirmed beyond being able to reach Annesburg.
reward: Viking helmet and the Viking Hatchet.

markers.title: Viking burial
markers.directions: On the rocky shore northeast of Annesburg. Map hints often put it under the R in Roanoke.
markers.note: Helmet and Viking Hatchet. The same mound is on the Hidden Places map.

name: Meteor House
region: New Hanover — west of Brandywine Drop
where: A ruined house along the railroad west of Brandywine Drop and south of the Abandoned Trading Post.
steps: Follow the tracks west of Brandywine Drop to the smashed house.
Take the meteorite from the smoking hole in the floor.
Ride northwest, across the tracks, to the larger crater and take the second piece.
requirements: Roanoke Ridge. No chapter clock is confirmed.
reward: Two meteorites. They are keepsakes. A heat or health effect is sometimes described; this guide only promises the two pieces you can pick up.

markers.title: Meteor House
markers.region: New Hanover — west of Brandywine Drop
markers.directions: Along the railroad west of Brandywine Drop, south of the Abandoned Trading Post. The meteorite is in the floor.
markers.note: The second piece is in the crater to the northwest.

name: Meteor crater
region: New Hanover — northwest of Meteor House
where: A barren crater in the trees northwest of Meteor House.
steps: From Meteor House, cross the tracks northwest.
Pick up the meteorite in the middle of the crater.
requirements: Same area as Meteor House. No separate quest giver.
reward: The second meteorite.

markers.title: Meteor crater
markers.region: New Hanover — northwest of Meteor House
markers.directions: Northwest of Meteor House, across the railroad tracks. The piece is in the center of the crater.
markers.note: Second of two confirmed meteorites.

name: Third meteorite
region: Unknown — not pinned
where: After the house and the crater, the satchel can read 2 of 3.
steps: Pick up the two confirmed pieces.
Do not trust a Moonstone Pond theory or a cave-on-the-border theory. Neither has been confirmed.
requirements: Unconfirmed.
reward: No third piece is confirmed.
uncertain: The 2 of 3 count is real. The location of a third meteorite has never been confirmed.

name: Dreamcatchers
region: All across the map — individual trees are not pinned
where: Twenty dreamcatchers hang in trees. The reward is in the Elysian Pool cave.
steps: From Chapter 2 on, search in any order. Nothing here is missable.
A nearby dreamcatcher makes a soft sound, and a controller rumbles. In Eagle Eye the right tree is dusted gold. It is usually a lone dead tree.
This release does not pin all 20 trees. They were not rechecked one by one.
After the twentieth, ride to Elysian Pool, walk through the waterfall, and keep left until a side chamber on the right.
Inspect the cave paintings. The Ancient Arrowhead is in the eye of the bison.
requirements: Chapter 2 onward. Any order. The cave is the same waterfall cave as the Poisonous Trail.
reward: Ancient Arrowhead. Stamina lasts about twice as long while you use a bow. A Fence can also buy it, so keep it if you want the bow effect.
uncertain: Individual tree coordinates are not listed because they were not re-verified for this release.

name: Dinosaur bones
region: World collectible — individual bones are not pinned
where: Thirty bones. You mail each location to Deborah MacGuiness from any post office.
steps: Inspect a bone when you find one. The location is mailed, not the bone itself.
Send them from a post office and wait for her replies.
After all 30, accept her invitation.
Individual dig sites are not pinned here. They were not rechecked one by one.
requirements: You can start when you find a bone and use the mail. Her invitation waits until all 30 are sent.
reward: The Jawbone Knife, after the full set and her invitation.
uncertain: Bone-by-bone coordinates are not in this release.

name: Rock carvings (Geology for Beginners)
region: West Elizabeth — Francis Sinclair's hut, northwest of Strawberry
where: Start at the hut northwest of Strawberry. Ten carvings are scattered after that.
steps: Talk to Francis Sinclair at the hut. He wants the carvings and will not explain why.
Inspect each carving. Arthur records the location. Mail the coordinates from a post office.
One mailed carving returns $10 and Kentucky Bourbon, after about a day.
Five mailed carvings return the Rock Statue.
All ten return an invitation. Go back to the hut.
You find Francis's father dead. His mother is there with a baby who has Francis's birthmark, and a mural made from your drawings.
Take the Old Brass Compass from the table. A Fence uses it to craft the Raven Claw Talisman.
The ten carving sites are not pinned individually in this release.
requirements: Chapter 2. Mail from a post office. Allow about a day between rewards.
reward: $10 and Kentucky Bourbon, then the Rock Statue, then the invitation, the mural scene, and the Old Brass Compass.
uncertain: Individual carving coordinates were not re-verified, so only the hut is marked.

markers.title: Francis Sinclair's hut
markers.directions: The hut northwest of Strawberry. Talk to Francis, then mail rock-carving locations from a post office.
markers.note: Start of Geology for Beginners. The ten carvings are not pinned one by one.

name: Gilded Bachelor
region: Not confirmed
where: No matching easter egg was found under this name.
steps: Do not hunt a secret called the Gilded Bachelor. It was not confirmed as its own mystery.
The Gilded Cage is a Chapter 4 story mission, the mayor's party in Saint Denis. That is a mission, not this secret.
requirements: Not confirmed.
reward: None. There is no verified reward because the secret itself was not verified.
uncertain: Checked as a distinct easter egg and not found. The similar name The Gilded Cage is a story mission.

name: Fossilized man
region: New Hanover — northern Roanoke Ridge
where: A rock in the shape of a man on the northern path through Roanoke Ridge, southwest of the meteor crater. IGN's meteor note places the crater northeast of this rock.
steps: Ride the northernmost path in Roanoke Ridge.
Inspect the standing rock that looks like a person.
It is a point of interest, not a fight.
requirements: Roanoke Ridge. No clock is confirmed.
reward: A journal point of interest.

markers.title: Fossilized man
markers.directions: On the northern path through Roanoke Ridge, southwest of the meteor crater.
markers.note: A rock shaped like a man. Journal only.

name: Whale bones
region: West Elizabeth — ridge west of Lake Owanjila
where: The ridge west of Lake Owanjila.
steps: Ride the ridge on the west side of Lake Owanjila.
Inspect the whale bones.
requirements: Big Valley / Owanjila access. No clock is confirmed.
reward: A journal point of interest. No item is confirmed.

markers.title: Whale bones
markers.region: West Elizabeth — west of Lake Owanjila
markers.directions: Climb the ridge west of Lake Owanjila and inspect the bones.
markers.note: Point of interest. No confirmed loot.

name: Manito Glade
region: New Hanover — Roanoke Ridge
where: Manito Glade, a hidden pagan site in Roanoke Ridge.
steps: Find the glade in Roanoke Ridge.
Inspect the ritual circle. Do not expect a quest marker.
A hostile hermit is associated with this country. Save before you linger.
requirements: Roanoke Ridge. No clock is confirmed for the circle itself.
reward: The ritual site and a journal entry. No cash amount is confirmed.
uncertain: The circle is a known point of interest. Extra claims, including anything supernatural about the hermit, are not pinned down here.

markers.title: Manito Glade
markers.directions: Search Roanoke Ridge for the pagan circle at Manito Glade.
markers.note: Ritual site. Save if someone nearby turns hostile.

name: Marko Dragic's robot
region: New Hanover — Doverhill, northeast of Annesburg
where: Doverhill laboratory, northeast of Annesburg. The robot is finished later in the high Grizzlies.
steps: Go to Doverhill and start A Bright Bouncing Boy with Marko Dragic.
Help him run the experiment at the lab.
Later, during a thunderstorm, climb to his robot in the high Grizzlies near Colter.
The storm is required for that last meeting. If the sky is clear, sleep and return.
requirements: The stranger mission at Doverhill, then a thunderstorm for the robot in the Grizzlies.
reward: The Electric Lantern, from the robot.
uncertain: The lab pin is Doverhill. The robot's mountain is the high Grizzlies during a storm; a separate summit pin was not added.

markers.title: Marko Dragic at Doverhill
markers.directions: Doverhill, northeast of Annesburg. Start the experiment here. The robot is a later trip into the Grizzlies during a thunderstorm.
markers.note: Reward is the Electric Lantern after the storm meeting.

name: Icarus and Friends
region: Ambarino — Grizzlies
where: A wrecked flying machine in the Grizzlies, with several bodies around it.
steps: Search the northern Grizzlies for the broken glider.
Inspect the wreck and the bodies.
The pin is regional. Guides do not agree on one ridge, so this marker only puts you in the right part of Ambarino.
requirements: Ambarino. No clock is confirmed.
reward: A journal point of interest.
uncertain: The wreck is real. The exact ridge was not settled tightly enough for a precise pin, so the marker is regional.

markers.title: Icarus and Friends
markers.directions: Search the northern Grizzlies for a wrecked flying machine and several bodies. This pin is regional.
markers.note: Point of interest. Exact ridge is marked as regional, not surveyed.

name: Mysterious Hill Home
region: Ambarino — Grizzlies East, near the Donner Falls country
where: A house on a hill in the same northern country as Window Rock and the Strange Statues.
steps: Find the hill house and look at it.
Turn away, then look again. It does not stay as you first saw it.
Inspect whatever is left and check the journal. It is not a combat encounter.
requirements: Ambarino. No clock is confirmed.
reward: A journal point of interest.
uncertain: The changing house is a known point of interest. The pin sits in that northern country and is not a door-by-door survey.

markers.title: Mysterious Hill Home
markers.directions: In the Grizzlies East near the Donner Falls and Window Rock country. Look at the house, turn away, and look again.
markers.note: Regional pin. Journal point of interest, not a fight.

name: Pleasance
region: Lemoyne — Scarlett Meadows
where: The abandoned town of Pleasance in Scarlett Meadows.
steps: Ride into the empty town.
Inspect the houses and the graveyard. Something is wrong with the place, and the journal records it.
Do not expect a boss fight.
requirements: Scarlett Meadows, once that part of Lemoyne is open. No clock is confirmed.
reward: A journal point of interest.

markers.title: Pleasance
markers.directions: The abandoned town in Scarlett Meadows. Walk the houses and the graves.
markers.note: Journal point of interest.

name: Two Crows skeleton
region: New Austin — Two Crows
where: Two Crows, a named spot in New Austin.
steps: Reach New Austin in the epilogue.
Go to Two Crows and inspect the skeleton posed with a donkey skull.
requirements: Epilogue access to New Austin in a normal playthrough.
reward: A journal point of interest. No item is confirmed.

markers.title: Two Crows skeleton
markers.directions: At Two Crows in New Austin, inspect the skeleton with the donkey skull. Epilogue access.
markers.note: Point of interest. New Austin is locked until the epilogue.
